questions.concept: Overload resolution for int and double arguments
questions.explanation: f(5) matches the int version and returns 10; f(5.0) matches the double version and returns 2.5. The sum is 12.5.

questions.concept: SSL and TLS placement in OSI list
questions.question: In the OSI layer-wise protocol list of the syllabus, SSL and TLS are placed under which layer?
questions.explanation: The syllabus lists TCP, UDP, SSL and TLS as Transport layer protocols, even though Presentation handles encryption.

questions.question: Which deadlock condition states that a resource cannot be forcefully taken from a process and can only be released voluntarily by it?
questions.explanation: No Pre-emption means no process can forcibly take another process's resources; release happens only voluntarily.

questions.concept: Set of commands that are all DDL
questions.question: Which set consists only of DDL commands?
questions.explanation: DDL commands are CREATE, ALTER, DROP and TRUNCATE; INSERT and UPDATE are DML and GRANT is DCL.

questions.concept: Why DDoS is harder to counter than DoS
questions.question: Why is a DDoS attack harder to counter than a simple DoS attack?

options.A: It intercepts private conversations in real time
options.B: It encrypts the victim's data and demands a ransom
options.C: Its requests come from many compromised systems spread over a wide area
options.D: It needs physical access to the target server

questions.explanation: In DDoS the illegitimate requests originate from many distributed compromised systems (often a botnet), so blocking a single source does not stop it.

questions.question: Why are digital products (such as e-books or software) considered best suited to B2C e-commerce?

options.A: They can be sold only through government tenders
options.B: They avoid the need for any payment gateway
options.C: They require a physical warehouse close to every buyer
options.D: They can be delivered to the consumer at the time of purchase

questions.explanation: Digital products are best suited to B2C because they can be delivered instantly at the time of purchase.

questions.question: The two pumping lemmas are stated for which pair of language classes?
questions.explanation: There are two pumping lemmas, one for regular languages and one for context-free languages.

questions.question: In digital marketing, SERP stands for:
questions.explanation: SERP is the Search Engine Results Page, where rankings improved by SEO appear.

questions.concept: Queue removal order for A, B, C, D
questions.question: The elements A, B, C and D are inserted into a queue in that order and then deleted one at a time. In what order are they removed?
questions.explanation: A queue is FIFO, so elements leave in the order they entered: ABCD. DCBA would be the stack (LIFO) order.

questions.question: Which software process model is particularly known for its emphasis on testing, pairing each development stage with a corresponding test activity?
questions.explanation: The V-model emphasises testing; it is the model highlighted in the syllabus for this characteristic.

questions.question: Sharing and pooling of resources in cloud computing, which forms its backbone, is called:
questions.explanation: Virtualization creates virtual versions of servers, storage, networks and operating systems and is the backbone of cloud computing.

questions.concept: assert with false expression stops execution
questions.question:
What happens when the following code runs?
def check(n):
    assert n >= 0, 'Negative'
    print('OK')
check(-5)

options.B: AssertionError is raised with the message 'Negative' and 'OK' is not printed
options.C: ValueError is raised because -5 is negative
options.D: It prints 'OK' and then raises AssertionError

questions.explanation: When the asserted expression is False, AssertionError is raised with the given message, and the statements after it in the block are not executed.

questions.concept: Kruskal starts with least weighted edge
questions.question: Which statement correctly describes how Kruskal's algorithm begins?

options.A: It starts with the least weighted edge in the whole graph
options.B: It starts from the heaviest edge and removes edges
options.C: It starts from an arbitrary vertex and grows from it
options.D: It starts from the vertex with the highest degree

questions.explanation: Kruskal chooses the minimum weight edge from all edges, starting with the least weighted edge. Starting from any vertex is Prim's approach.

questions.concept: Maintenance gives long life to the system
questions.question: Which SDLC phase is credited with giving a long life to a newly developed system through enhancements, upgrades and bug fixes?
questions.explanation: Maintenance (with evaluation) is where enhancements, upgrades and bug fixes are done, giving the system a long life.

questions.question: What is the main objective of supervised machine learning?

options.A: To learn only through hit-and-trial feedback
options.B: To map an input variable (x) to an output variable (y)
options.C: To store facts and rules in a knowledge base
options.D: To discover hidden groupings without any supervision

questions.explanation: Supervised learning trains on known data to map input x to output y. Hidden groupings is unsupervised and hit-and-trial feedback is reinforcement learning.

questions.concept: Key attribute shown as underlined text
questions.question: How is a key attribute, which represents the primary key, shown in an ER diagram?

options.D: As underlined text in an oval

questions.explanation: A key attribute is shown with its name underlined; a dashed oval is a derived attribute and a double ellipse is multivalued.

questions.concept: Long-term scheduler loads processes for multiprogramming
questions.question: Which scheduler brings processes from the hard disk into RAM to support multiprogramming?
questions.explanation: The long-term scheduler admits processes from disk into RAM. The medium-term scheduler swaps processes in and out, and the short-term scheduler selects a ready process for the CPU.

questions.question: Keys 50, 30, 70, 20, 40 are inserted in that order into an empty binary search tree (left value less than parent, right value greater). What is the right child of 30?
questions.explanation: 50 is the root, 30 goes left, 70 right; 20 < 30 goes left of 30, and 40 (less than 50, greater than 30) becomes the right child of 30.

questions.question: The two types of ASCII are:
questions.explanation: ASCII-7 represents 128 characters and ASCII-8 represents 256 characters.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of opening a file using with open('f.txt', 'r') as f:?

options.A: The file cannot be read inside the block
options.B: The file is closed automatically when the block ends
options.C: The file contents are pickled automatically
options.D: The file is opened in binary mode automatically

questions.explanation: With the with clause, the file is closed automatically when control leaves the block, so close() does not have to be called.

questions.question: In which cache mapping technique is data picked from RAM placed at a fixed place in the cache?
questions.explanation: Direct mapping places each block at a fixed cache position; associative mapping can place it anywhere.

questions.concept: Basic operations a Turing machine can perform
questions.question: Which of the following are listed as basic operations that a Turing machine can perform? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Turing machines can copy strings, delete symbols and accept palindromes, but the halting problem is unsolvable by any TM.

questions.concept: Automatic garbage collection not supported in C++
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT supported in C++?
questions.explanation: C++ supports multiple inheritance, smart pointers and virtual destructors, but it has no automatic garbage collection; memory from new must be released with delete.

questions.question: Which antivirus method monitors the behaviour of an application while it is running in active memory?
questions.explanation: Real-time protection monitors suspicious activity while an application is running in active memory; sandbox detection runs files in a virtual environment instead.

questions.question: Which IEEE standard and technology pair is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: 802.15.1 is Bluetooth; 802.11 is WLAN, 802.3 Ethernet, 802.6 MAN and 802.15 PAN.
